title: om.hypotheses.recorded entry
description: Level 1's quarantined hypotheses, with the dreams setting on (docs/brain-memory.md, decision 5; docs/memory-v2.md, "Dreams"): at most 3 per compaction, each one redacted line citing records the prompt showed. They are never records, never in a fact class, never promoted or indexed, and shown only in the summary's dream section (scenario 20). id is the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 of hypothesis NUL content. Source: memory/consolidate/hypotheses.go, memory/hooks/consolidate_v2.go (appendLevel1), lisp/src/consolidate/validate.lisp, lisp/src/server/level1.lisp.
